heading: Wednesday Night
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Lows from the mid 50s to lower 60s, some lower 50s far north. Winds becoming light, variable to north.

heading: Thursday
text: Mostly cloudy. Slight chance of a morning shower in the Hudson Valley, then scattered in the afternoon from the Champlain Valley south and east, most numerous from Route 4 southward. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s. Winds light and variable.

heading: Thursday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Scattered early showers from the Champlain Valley south and east, tapering off. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60, cooler hollows in the lower 50s. Winds becoming northwest 5 to 10 mph.
